title: Observability: ioctl_init -EBUSY path emits no log
description: When ioctl_init is called on an already-initialized fd (fd_type != FDTYPE_UNSET), it returns -EBUSY (line 742) with no log message. A support engineer cannot tell from the ring buffer that a double-INIT was attempted, what algo was requested, or what the fd was already initialized as. This is a common application bug that currently produces a silent kernel-side failure.
